title: Google releases a new local-first Granola competitor
summary: Google 推出 AI Edge Foresight，可在 Apple Silicon Mac 上离线记录会议并结合本地模型整理笔记，支持文件构建知识库。
investorNote: 端侧办公 AI 的差异化从转写质量延伸到隐私、离线和企业知识检索。

fact.subject: Google
fact.object: 本地会议笔记应用 AI Edge Foresight

evidence.quote:
Earlier in April, Google released
an AI-powered dictation tool that worked with local models
. Now, the same team has released a new competitor to the AI note-taker Granola and others, which it calls
Google AI Edge Foresight
The Mac app can work completely offline, utilizing the on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model, with 740 million parameters, to capture meeting notes across apps, including those from in-person meetings.

displayTitle: Google 推出离线会议笔记应用 Foresight，运行于 Mac 本地
narrative: Google 发布 AI Edge Foresight，报道显示它能在 Apple Silicon Mac 上完全离线工作，记录会议并让用户与笔记和上传文档对话。它使用端侧 EmbeddingGemma 2 等模型；目前更像本地模型能力展示，尚不能据此推断 Google 已取得会议工具市场份额。对敏感会议场景，离线处理是比通用摘要更明确的产品切口。

eventRelation.reason: 这是新应用发布，与此前本地听写工具属独立产品。
